short: AIAS 3.0 adds a third score, Coverage: whether AI answers name a brand across the buying situations of its category or only in a few, read against how often the brand is named at all. Asked {{L:a.cep_per_cat}} questions per category that name no brand, the newest models' answers gave a Coverage score that did not follow Presence (rank correlation {{L:a.h1.rho}} within category) or Consistency ({{L:a.h2.rho}}).
The score depends on which situations are asked. {{P:PRED_SENTENCE}}
